verses.t: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree
verses.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

verses.t: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months
verses.pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

verses.t: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter
verses.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees

verses.t: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
verses.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn
